questions.question: In which of the following years did Mahatma Gandhi lead the Satyagraha and hunger strike for the first time in India?
questions.questionHtml: In which of the following years did Mahatma Gandhi lead the Satyagraha and hunger strike for the first time in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 1918.

Mahatma Gandhi led the first Satyagraha and hunger strike during the Ahmedabad Mill Strike in 1918. In 1918, Mahatma Gandhi led the Ahmedabad Mill Strike, advocating for textile workers' rights against poor working conditions and low wages. This movement marked one of Gandhi's early experiments with non-violent satyagraha, introducing hunger strikes to the Indian masses. The strike was significant in shaping the working-class movement during India's freedom struggle. This marks the first recorded instance of Gandhi employing hunger strike as a tool of non-violent resistance.

Why NOT 1917 is a correct answer?

1917 was the year of Mahatma Gandhi's first Satyagraha in India, which was the Champaran Satyagraha.

However, the reason 1918 is noted as the year of his first hunger strike is due to the Ahmedabad Mill Strike. While the Champaran Satyagraha in 1917 marked his first use of the non-violent protest, it was during the Ahmedabad Mill Strike in 1918 that he employed the hunger strike tactic for the first time. So, both years are significant for different aspects of his non-violent resistance methods.
